summary: Iteration 2 regression: DEM terrain (Open-Meteo 3x3 Horn's method) + SMS blast (LOG_ONLY) + Recipients CRUD. Backend: 10/10 iter2 tests + 4/4 ML regression tests all pass. Frontend: /recipients page renders provider chip (LOG_ONLY), banner, 3 seeded recipients (Meghalaya/as, Sikkim/ne, Mizoram/lus), add + delete flows work, delivery ledger shows NER-001 alert fan-out only to matching recipients (as + lus, NOT ne) in their preferred languages. nav-recipients link routes correctly. DEM bootstrap successfully flipped all 22 zones to terrain_source='DEM_OPEN_METEO'. NER-009 (Bomdila Slope) shows elevation_m > 1500 and slope_deg > 5 (real DEM). run-all still returns ok=22 failed=0 with new terrain.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iter1: sklearn 1.8.0→1.9.0 InconsistentVersionWarning on unpickle. Numerical parity still holds (regression asserts <1e-6).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 694 lines — right at the 700-line split threshold. Strongly recommend extracting recipients + notifications + terrain routes into app/api/*.py routers next iteration.

sms_service.blast_alert district match uses `$or: [{district: zone.district}, {district: null}, {district: ''}]` — correct behaviour for nation-wide subscribers. Verified: Sikkim recipient correctly excluded from NER-001 (East Khasi Hills) alert.

DEM bootstrap correctly runs as background asyncio task on startup, is idempotent (only picks zones where terrain_source='DEMO'), and gracefully continues on per-zone failures. Zones stuck on DEMO remain testable via POST /api/terrain/recompute.
Twilio credentials read via os.environ.get() at every call — correct; enabling only requires setting env vars and restarting.
All Mongo _id fields stripped via _strip helper; recipients POST also pops _id post-insert.
Frontend Recipients.jsx uses data-testid on every interactive element (nav, form fields, add-btn, per-row del-<id>, notif-<id>). Excellent testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all recipients flows: page load, provider chip, banner, seed data, add, delete, nav link, ledger)

test_credentials: Role-based only (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Twilio deliberately unset — LOG_ONLY path verified.
seed_data_creation: Test recipients (TEST_QA Officer, TEST_UI Officer) created and cleaned up within each test. A TEST_iter2 alert was fired on NER-001 which persists in db.alerts + db.notifications (log-only, no side-effect on external systems).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter2 backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter2_dem_sms.py — 10 tests. POST /api/alerts requires severity field (schema: zone_id + reason + severity). BASE_URL read via helper _base_url() with /app/frontend/.env fallback. DEM bootstrap can take ~30s on first startup — test uses polling for terrain_source=DEM_OPEN_METEO. When TWILIO_* env vars are added, notifications/status.provider flips to TWILIO and blast_alert switches to real send_sms — retest with credentials in place.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One test failure during authoring (POST /api/alerts missing 'severity') was a test-side omission, fixed by adding severity='HIGH' to payload.
